description: keeper plugin hooks. SessionStart names the profiles; PreToolUse denies raw database clients aimed at a registered host and keeper commands only a person may run, and allows keeper's own MCP tools. band.tsx draws the waiting-ticket count above the prompt. All of it runs `keeper hook`, from ~/.local/bin when keeper is not on PATH, reads the daemon, and never starts it.

hooks.command: PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin"; command -v keeper >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec keeper hook session-start
PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin"; command -v keeper >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec keeper hook pre-tool-use
